about.memo-description: The Memo is open source software and aims to provide facilitators with a quick and easy access to the game cards (especially on mobiles). It can be installed for any game cards based on the same ideas than the Climate Fresk.
about.optout: To measure its audience the Memo uses MatomoMatomo in accordance with CNIL recommendations.
about.optout-button: Click here to deactivate opt-out from Matomo
